events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, dying six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost an icon. Remembering the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of Tupac Shakur today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Honouring Hendrix
angles.copy: Still electrifying audiences decades later. Today, we remember the groundbreaking artistry of Jimi Hendrix, 56 years on.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was unleashed on the world this day in 1969. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde was born on this day in 1951, turning 75.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher was born on this day in 1972, turning 54.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Still rocking stages and headlines! Wishing a very Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher.

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Still inspiring generations with its message of peace. John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released this day in 1975.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple launched the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod changed everything when it was released on this day in 2001. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating everyone's favourite secret agent and the film series that started it all in 1962.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon was born on this day in 1940, and would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the extraordinary life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. Imagine.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese was born on this day in 1939, turning 87.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour has brought joy to millions. Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: A double album that pushed boundaries. The Beatles' 'White Album' was released this day in 1968. What's your favourite track from this iconic record?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Still the champion of our hearts. Today marks 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, a true legend.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop music history. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, showcasing their evolving sound.
